# security — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Security scanning (tx-scan, token-scan, dapp-scan, sig-scan). Required flags are in the signature; `ocl security <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### security token-scan
Batch token security scan — detect honeypots, high tax, mint risks
`ocl security token-scan [options]`
- `--tokens <TOKENS>` — Explicit token list: chainId:contractAddress, comma-separated (up to 10)
- `--address <ADDRESS>` — Wallet address whose token holdings will be scanned
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain name or ID filter used with --address or logged-in wallet mode (e.g. ethereum, solana, xlayer, 1, 501, 196)
- `--trade-direction <TRADE_DIRECTION>` — Trade direction of the token being scanned in this transaction: buy (receiving, stricter) or sell (spending, allows exit)

### security dapp-scan
DApp / URL security scan — detect phishing sites, blacklisted domains
`ocl security dapp-scan --domain <DOMAIN>`

### security tx-scan
Transaction pre-execution security scan (EVM & Solana)
`ocl security tx-scan --from <FROM> --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--to <TO>` — Target address (EVM only)
- `--data <DATA>` — Transaction calldata, hex-encoded (EVM only)
- `--value <VALUE>` — Transaction value in wei, hex string (EVM only)
- `--gas <GAS>` — Gas limit (EVM only)
- `--gas-price <GAS_PRICE>` — Gas price (EVM only)
- `--encoding <ENCODING>` — Encoding format: base58 or base64 (Solana only)
- `--transactions <TRANSACTIONS>` — Transaction payloads, comma-separated (Solana only)

### security approvals
Query token approval / permit2 authorizations
`ocl security approvals --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Comma-separated chain names or indexes (e.g. "ethereum,base" or "1,8453")
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Number of results per page (default: 20) (default 20)
- `--cursor <CURSOR>` — Pagination cursor from previous response

### security sig-scan
Message signature security scan — detect phishing signatures (EIP-712, personal_sign)
`ocl security sig-scan --from <FROM> --chain <CHAIN> --sig-method <SIG_METHOD> --message <MESSAGE>`
